rationale: A skill is instructions, not code. It may run repository scripts from this allow-list and nothing else; it ships no script of its own, so there is no code path a future edit could smuggle into a session (ADR-030 §3).
refuses: publishing when design:sync-status is not ok/never-synced/stale
publishing a --neutral bundle into a client project
recording a sync without a remote manifest hash
any network call other than the design-system publish itself
